name: ihp_sg13g2
description: Open IHP SG13G2 130nm SiGe BiCMOS (HBT) — IHP (Germany); a growing choice for open analog/RF with real shuttle access. Mirrored under github.com/vyges-tools. The HBT/RF devices live in the primitives; this descriptor presents the digital sg13g2_stdcell view (mixed-signal/RF via the device models). Name id uses underscore (ihp_sg13g2) per the descriptor name rule; the repo is ihp-open-pdk and root is its ihp-sg13g2 subdir. Paths illustrative. SOURCE MOVED 2026-09-01: upstream merged the SG13CMOS-5L overlay into IHP-Open-PDK (PR #1124, head ab1510c), so ihp-sg13g2/, ihp-sg13cmos5l/ and ihp-common/ now sit in one tree on that repository's dev branch and ONE commit pin covers base and overlay together. dev is a COMMIT PIN, not a release: it carries no version tags, so quote upstream.ref, never a version number. The tree also carries git submodules under ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ — materialize with --recurse-submodules or the PDK is silently incomplete. Tagged releases (v0.3.0 and earlier) still exist on the mirror's main branch; they predate the merge and do not contain the overlay.
